milestones.title: The Chancellor's Initial Oath
milestones.phase: Era I - Dawn of the Empire
milestones.description: Swearing the founding Oath of Supremacy while Exiles plot rebellions from the Hinterlands and Cradle.

milestones.title: First Dynastic Succession
milestones.description: The victor's vision archives cards into the World Deck, fundamentally changing the realm's religions, secrets, and warfare.

milestones.title: Rise of the Citizen Vanguard
milestones.description: Former exiles are offered citizenship, corrupting imperial relics and vying to usurp the chancellor's bloodline.

milestones.title: Twilight of the High Dynasty
milestones.phase: Era IV - Age of Dark Secrets
milestones.description: Ancient forgotten visions take hold of the Provinces as secret arcana and conspiracy cards flood the court.

milestones.title: The Eternal Chronicle
milestones.description: Sealing the master Chronicle box, enshrining centuries of player-driven history, betrayal, and sovereign rule.
